senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; denom. of יָרַד) [running away, running against, cmp. מַעַל,] desertion, rebellion.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 55b:7">Pes. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>אחר שלשה למִרְדָהּ</he> after three days since her (the bird’s) deserting the eggs; <cite ref="Pesachim 55b:7">ib.</cite> <he>למוֹרְדָהּ</he>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 90:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. XC</cite> <he>בשביל המ׳ שמרדתי אני וכ׳</he> I beg for amnesty for the rebellion which I made.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23:7">Gen. R. s. 23</cite>; s. 26 (ref. to <he>הוחל</he>, <he>החל</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 4:26">Gen. IV, 26</cite>; <cite ref="Genesis 6:1">VI, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Genesis 10:8">X, 8</cite>) <he>לשון מ׳</he> it means desertion from the Lord (cmp. <cite ref="H01073"><he>חָלַל</he></cite>, <cite ref="H00351"><he>חוּלִּין</he></cite>); a. fr.—<he>איגרת מ׳</he> a document stating a wife’s, or a husband’s, refusal of duties, v. <cite ref="M02528"><he>מָרַד</he> I</cite>.
Keth. 64ᵃ; Y. ib. V, 30ᵇ bot.; Y. Kidd. I, 59ᵃ bot.; a. fr.—Pl. מְרָדִים rebellious acts, contrad. to sins of passion (זדונות).
<cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 2:1">Tosef. Yoma II, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 36b">Yoma 36ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. III, 40ᵈ bot., v. <cite ref="Q02087"><he>פֶּשַׁע</he></cite>.
